Tier 1 (Level 1) — The Moon

  • Tactical: You learn Message and gain a skill rank in Lore.
  • Strategic: Soft Power marks cap +2.

Crew Type (Bad Eden): Covert Ops Cell.

“If you saw it happen, it wasn’t us.”

Covert Ops cells make wars quiet. They prefer locks to speeches, shadows to banners, and results to credit. They don’t start fights—they rearrange the board so the fight never happens.

  • Tactical Identity: You gain a skill rank in Stealth and with the Tinkering aptitude.
  • Strategic Identity: Your Domain starts with +1 Intrigue OPs.

Human. Normalized Bad Eden ancestry root.

Select one heritage separately when building the character: Cro-Magnon, Denisovan, Florensis, Neanderthal.

This root grants the shared Human core trait package and preserves live UUID compatibility for existing feature items.

“Humanity is not special. It’s just stubborn enough to keep moving when reality begs it to stop.”

Adaptive. 1/Soma Break, when you fail a check, you can choose to succeed instead.

Tenacious. While you have 1 Integrity, you reroll the lowest die on one check of your choice each round (declare before rolling).

Lineage Memory. Choose one human lineage (Cro-Magnon, Denisovan, Florensis, Neanderthal). Your lineage grants Tier powers as you level.

Tier 1 — Goetic Summoner

“First lesson: the circle protects you. Second lesson: only if it’s perfect.”

You learn the etiquette of predators: names, constraints, and the price of eye contact. You are not yet strong enough to command, but you are strong enough to be heard.

Tactical (Character Scale)

  • Gain a skill rank in Occult and Intimidation
  • Learn Find Familiar, flavored as unsettling, watchful, or veil-adjacent

Strategic (Faction Scale)

  • When your Domain attempts intimidation, coercion, or violent leverage, gain +1 to the relevant Violence marks roll
  • When your Domain runs reconnaissance, blackmail, or covert acquisition, gain +1 to the relevant Intrigue marks roll
  • When your Domain attempts goodwill, legitimacy, or mass Diplomacy, suffer –1 to the relevant Soft Power marks roll

Cost: early Goetic work leaves an obvious scent. Expect attention from the wrong entities, fear from the right people, and a reputation that arrives before you do.

items.name: Route of the Black Stair (Bad Eden)

system.source: Bad Eden Originals — Sprint F (2026 rules)

description.value:
"You came through a door that wasn't for them."

Doctrine: Thresholds weaponized — covert, predatory; who gets through and who really, really doesn't.

The Black Stair is the courier as ambush. Your Surge spends turn crossings into kills: strike from where they weren't watching, slam the threshold shut on a foe, and spring the stair that does not end.

Route (spent via Surge)

  • Ambush (1) — your next Strike +Tier d6; the target's next attack is rolling 3d10 and keeping the lowest 2.
  • Cut Off (2) — a foe is Staggered and cannot take reactions until your next turn.
  • Stair-Trap (5) — your next Strike lands as a max-die crit and knocks the target Prone; if it drops them, you regain a freed action.

Occult Association (Bad Eden): Goetic Summoner.

“I have friends. They’re just… contractual.”

Goetic Summoners do not worship. They do not submit. They negotiate.

To a Goetic, the Great Work is not merely a path of purification. It is a war over leverage. Power exists in the Shatterlands, and much of it has teeth, names, appetites, and terms. If you can name it, you can sometimes bind it. If you can bind it, you can make it useful. For a while.

Goetics build circles, memorize taboos, track debts, and turn predatory forces into temporary infrastructure. They call this control. The world calls it an incident report waiting to happen.

How Goetics pursue the Great Work:

  • By extracting leverage from Qliphothic forces instead of merely resisting them
  • By binding hazards into assets and paying the price later
  • By treating Darkness as a resource with teeth
  • By weaponizing fear, coercion, and forbidden access where cleaner traditions would hesitate

Resonance: Qliphoth / Shadow — rupture, appetite, inversion, and the dangerous intelligence inside corruption.

Tell-tales: counted names, precise circles, a room that feels like it already agreed to terms before anyone spoke.

Faction Effects (Passive):

  • +1 to Violence marks rolls
  • +1 to Intrigue marks rolls

Cost Principle: every Goetic gain creates obligation. Expect Debt, escalating Darkness pressure, hostile notice, and consequences that remember your name longer than you wanted them to.

⚙ ENGINE NOTE — Pace is now ◆ Surge. Movement banks Surge (capped per round); your courier moves are the ◆ Surge menu's courier kit (Courier's Step / Ghoststep / Flank & Strike / No Such Door + your route's kit). Read Pace as Surge wherever it appears below.

"You're already moving. The fight rearranges around it."

The Shadow Courier runs on Surge, like everyone — but yours comes from motion. Move 30+ ft in a turn and you bank +1 Surge (again at 12 squares, max +2/round). A courier in motion has options; a courier standing still is just a target. The old Pace pool folds into this — same fuel, one number.

The Courier (spent via Surge)

  • Courier's Step (1) — +half-speed move (no provoke) and a freed reaction; flow through the fight.
  • Ghoststep (3) — DR equal to Tier till your next turn, and reposition out of danger.
  • Flank & Strike (5) — reposition, then your next Strike reroll the lowest die and +Tier d6.
  • No Such Door (8) — allies within Tier squares each gain a freed reaction and a reroll; open the road for the whole team.

The Package endures as your work — designate it, carry it, deliver it. Delivery banks your Surge to full and still triggers the route's strategic payoff (Intrigue marks, Darkness reduction, the arrival that mattered).

You’re learning the shape of your shadow. Expect mistakes. Budget for them.

Soul - Creative energy. +1 Violence, +1 Soft Power OPs

Creation arrives all at once. Chokmah rewards decisive action, inspired leadership, and bold openers that turn possibility into momentum before anyone else is ready.

New Heritage (v2). Cro-Magnon replaces Erectus in the Human heritage lineup.

“Humanity is the species that keeps walking even when the map says ‘stop.’”

Human (Cro-Magnon). You are not a fantasy human. You are the cognitive, symbolic, cooperative inheritance of the lineage that first painted ancestors on cave walls, buried its dead with flowers, and traded ochre across a continent it had no map for.

Where Neanderthal is strength and Florensis is reach, Cro-Magnon is pattern. Language, ritual, coalition. You are the human branch that kept explaining things until the explanation started working.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid.

  • Size. Medium.

  • Speed. 6 squares

  • Lineage Lean. Your lineage leans toward MND (Mind) or PRE (Presence)—expressed through Tier powers.

Core: Stubborn Spark

At creation you gain Stubborn Spark (Adaptive, Tenacious, Lineage Memory).

Cro-Magnon Tier Powers

You gain Tier I at creation, then Tier II (5), Tier III (11), Tier IV (17). Cro-Magnon powers emphasize: Symbolic Thought (ritual and language sensitivity), Coalition Instinct (cooperation bonuses with allies), Tool Mind (improvisational tool use), and Narrative Memory (lore retention that persists across generations).

system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
A locked door is a suggestion.

Mode: Thief / drift: Toward.

Your default Package type is either a Blade or a Key. Declare which you are carrying at the start of each scene; you may switch on a Soma Break.

  • Blade. A single opportunistic strike, deployable once. While carrying a Blade, your first attack from concealment or surprise in the scene deals an extra +1d10 kinetic damage with (blade). The damage explodes on 10s and banks Surge as normal. Using the strike consumes the Blade.

  • Key. A single-use access bypass. While carrying a Key, you may bypass one non-magical lock, ward, or password challenge without rolling, once per scene. Using the Key consumes it.

On delivery (resolving the Blade strike on its intended target, or using the Key on its intended barrier): no Pace refill from this base feature — see Class Tier 3 Package Mastery for the Black Stair delivery bonus.

You may designate a new Package on your next Soma Break or on entering a new scene if your slot is empty.

⚙ ENGINE NOTE — Pace is now ◆ Surge. Movement banks Surge (capped per round); your courier moves are the ◆ Surge menu's courier kit (Courier's Step / Ghoststep / Flank & Strike / No Such Door + your route's kit). Read Pace as Surge wherever it appears below.

You cross what isn't supposed to be crossed — and you always come out the other side carrying something.

On gaining Shadow Courier Initiation 1 you receive:

  • Skill rank +1 in Stealth (Intrigue).

  • Skill rank +1 in Tinkering (Intrigue).

  • Intrigue marks cap +2 and Logistics marks cap +2 on your Domain.

  • Pace pool comes online (movement-generated). Max = max(2, ceil((Intrigue value + Shadow Courier Initiation) / 3)), capped at 8. Refills on Soma Break and on Package delivery.

  • Package slot comes online — one Package at a time, type set by your chosen Route at L1.

Pace generation. Gain 1 Pace when you move at least 6 squares on your turn. Maximum 1 Pace generated per turn from this feature. Doctrine features may add their own generators.

Baseline Pace spends (free action, 1 Pace each):

  • Move 5 extra feet without spending an action.

  • Reroll a single Stealth (Intrigue), Athletics (Violence), or Tinkering (Intrigue) check — keep the new result.

  • Ignore a single reaction strike against you on this turn.

Liminal Sense. Once per encounter, ignore the first detection-style roll an opponent attempts against you (perception, scrying, Insight to read your intent, etc.). The roll is treated as if it had failed; resources spent on the attempt are not refunded.

“You were never alone in your body.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Moon (Ancient Blood). You carry something older than law. Memory moves through you. It expects to matter.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your presence amplifies symbolism, inherited legitimacy, buried memory, and eerie cultural authority. This Archetype is associated with +1 Soft Power in faction calculus in Bad Eden’s faction calculus.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for your full tactical and strategic toolkit; those are granted automatically by the Tier Engine at the appropriate character levels.

attributes (Archetype ASI)

When you choose this Archetype, you gain 3 attribute points to distribute using the 2024 rules (no more than +2 to any one score). You can assign them however you like, but common patterns include:

  • Dream-Blood Heir: +2 Presence, +1 Soul
  • Oracle of Buried Wars: +2 Soul, +1 Mind
  • Moon-Haunted Scion: +1 Mind, +1 Soul, +1 Presence

These are suggestions, not shackles. Any valid 3-point distribution is allowed; pick what matches the kind of character you want to be.
